<section_guide number="7" title="Out of Scope" references="1,2,3,4,5,6">
<purpose>Optionally record explicit exclusions before the Demo Scenario is written.</purpose>

<questions>
1. Only when the approved boundary is materially ambiguous: which users, flows, capabilities, edge cases, or claims should be explicitly excluded?
</questions>

<workflow>
This entire Section is optional. Review Sections 1-6. If the user already stated exclusions, show
them for confirmation. If the approved boundary is materially ambiguous, ask the one short question
above. Otherwise state that no explicit exclusions were provided and skip the Section without a
dedicated question.

Record every confirmed exclusion in one concise Explicit Exclusions list. Do not invent non-goals,
ask additional exclusion questions merely to fill the Section, or treat an unresolved choice as
excluded.
</workflow>

<completion required="false">Skip this Section when there are no explicit exclusions. Otherwise confirm and save 7.1 once.</completion>
</section_guide>
